title: Chapter 102: Mengzhong City
content:
Chapter 102: Mengzhong City

In fact, Wu Qing can decide whether to keep this city or not, but this is inconsistent with the personality Wu Qing wants to establish and is not conducive to the unity of the alliance.

As for matters related to external warfare, Wu Qing and the Zerg can make their own decisions because it has been agreed in advance. The army of the alliance fighting outside should also be dominated by Wu Qing and the Zerg.

Major decisions related to the future development direction of the alliance can be discussed to show respect for the lords of the alliance. The final decision-making power is still in the hands of Wu Qing.

There is no doubt that the Zerg fights, but in this deep and abyssal world, with the current strength of the Zerg, it can't make much waves.

The Zerg can't always bury their heads in fighting and killing. If they are independent in this world, they may provoke a big boss and give the Zerg a dimensionality reduction attack. Then everything will probably start all over again.

Therefore, the Zerg must integrate into this world as a newly born race under the protection of the system, and use the system to cheat and develop within the unique rules of this world.

Even if it is a little troublesome, only by being within the rules of the game can we not be easily targeted.

This is the important reason why Wu Qing is willing to spend so much time on the development of the alliance.

...

Now that the problem has been thrown to Wu Qing by the alliance lord, Wu Qing can take the opportunity to express his thoughts.

"The Zerg has gained strong support from the tribe through a war, and its military strength is continuously growing. Now there are enough troops to defend this place."

"My idea is to continue to occupy this place and build it. As Lord Hu Wei said, build it into a window for the alliance to the outside world."

"But in this way, we will definitely cause conflicts with the Tengu tribe, and everyone should be mentally prepared."

"In the future, the construction of this place requires the strong participation of all territories in the alliance. Only by gathering the strength of the entire alliance can we build this window city that represents the face of the alliance faster and better."

Wu Qing expressed his thoughts.

Everyone was very happy to hear Wu Qing say that the Zerg's military strength has increased greatly and is capable of occupying this place, and they are also very happy to participate in the construction of this place.

The lords of the alliance learned from Meng that everyone's contribution to the alliance's foreign wars would receive a considerable share of the benefits.

One of the main purposes of everyone coming here today is to distribute the spoils.

It can be seen that it is profitable to follow Wu Qing and the Zerg.

After clarifying the general direction, the next step is some detailed issues. Under the chairmanship of Hu Wei, everyone made suggestions on how to deal with the Tengu clan and the evil god camp and how to build this territory on the existing basis.

The lords of these independent territories in the alliance have their own unique features. Wu Qing has benefited a lot from their many suggestions and ideas for solving problems.

The world is different, and some of Wu Qing's ideas for solving problems are not necessarily suitable for this world. Inspired by these lords, many problems have been solved.

Wu Qing has always believed that everyone has his value, and he will not look down on others because of his previous identity.

After the details were discussed, a lord proposed to give a resounding name to the first territory city built by the alliance.

"Haha, how about calling it the First City of the Alliance?"

Meng was also interested when he heard this suggestion, and was the first to name it.

"Not appropriate, it's the same as your name, it's easy to be misunderstood!"

Hu Wei immediately objected, he felt that such a name was a bit embarrassing for him.

Everyone also felt that the name was not very good, so they thought hard and chose a name for themselves, hoping to get everyone's approval.

Everyone had their own ideas, and they couldn't reach a consensus. Finally, they looked at Wu Qing, hoping that he would comment on it.

Or Wu Qing could choose a name himself, and everyone would accept it.

"Wu Qing, you also say something!"

Meng said to Wu Qing on behalf of everyone.

Wu Qing was very clear about his naming skills, so he looked at Hu Wei, who had been silent. It would be more reliable to leave this kind of thing to Hu Wei, the old fox.

"Lord Hu Wei, you are the first one to oppose Meng's name. I guess you have already chosen a suitable name, right?"

"Why don't you take it out for appreciation? As long as more than half of the people agree, we will use your name!"

Wu Qing felt that it was unnecessary to waste time on a name. As long as Hu Wei's name was not too bad, he would use it directly.

If it really didn't work, he could only pick a random name to deal with it.

"This is the first important territory city jointly built after the establishment of our alliance. I will take two of them!"

"'Meng' and 'Zhong', how about the name 'Meng Zhong'?"

Hu Wei smiled and said the name he chose and the basis for the name, and he seemed full of confidence.

When everyone heard it, it was indeed better than what they chose, meaningful and nice.

"Not bad! This name is OK, I agree!"

Meng likes to be the first in everything, and he was the first to express his support for Hu Wei.

Other lords expressed their support one after another, and no one spoke out against it.

The name was decided in this way. Meng Zhong City represented the first important city established by the alliance.

"Why does this name sound so familiar to me?"

Wu Qing's long-lost memory seemed to be awakened, but was immediately interrupted by Meng.

"Wu Qing, this name is good, right? Is it decided?"

Meng finally confirmed with Wu Qing.

"The name is good, and everyone likes it. From now on, this place will be called Mengchong City!"

Wu Qing nodded, indicating that the issue was over.

Next, there is the distribution of the spoils. In this battle, the vast majority of the troops' contribution belongs to the Zerg, and the combined effect of all the alliance's territories is insignificant.

Only the five major territories sent an elite force, which could be regarded as making some effort on the battlefield. The others did not even step into the battlefield and could only be regarded as doing some logistics work.

Therefore, no matter how Wu Qing distributes the spoils, no one dares to have an opinion.

As part of a force participating in the war, each territory can more or less obtain some of the territory's basic luck under the rules and secretly.

With this gain alone, everyone is not at a loss because they have no losses.

The rules of the world are impartial and selfless. Whoever contributes how much effort can have their own evaluation without criticism.

The loot that Wu Qing is now sharing with everyone is the benefit given by the Daxia Territory and the Zerg. It can be regarded as additional income for each territory, and it is also a reward for each territory to actively help transport supplies.

Wu Qing was not stingy. He took part of the weapons, equipment and other materials that were urgently needed by the alliance's territories and used them as a reward pool for the alliance's overall contribution. The territories were distributed according to the alliance's contribution.

This is a choice that everyone is happy with. The military power of Daxia Territory is mainly Zerg, and there is no need for so many weapons and equipment.

Moreover, when the Great Xia Kingdom forms military forces other than the Zerg tribe, the equipment will definitely be based on the Zerg tribe's biological reproductive equipment. These weapons and equipment from the Evil God camp will eventually be traded to other territories in the alliance.

It's better to take it out now to win everyone's favor, leave the supplies needed by other Daxia leaders, and avoid the trouble of trading.

Kill two birds with one stone.
